title: Assassination of José Ferreira da Rocha, by the PRP-BR
summary: Wikidata item Q115473111, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "murder of a Public Security Police (PSP) agent by the Revolutionary Brigades, in an attempt to rob the Pinto de Magalhães Bank, in Porto, on March 17, 1976". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
